partner_result_applied.use: Converted its capped-basis score into an exact KL-divergence quantity and proved a universal near-coloop upper bound on that score; localized the remaining collar c>63/64.

pinned_claude_source.use: Applied the ruled one-sheet theorem to the target-valid stress family to obtain ess sup on majority-sign levels <= pi*sqrt(2), using a 2D product marginal without projected independence.

new_results.statement: For any rank-3 Parseval frame with a coordinate leverage c>1/2 and natural Pluecker law v_S=det(R_S)^2, every probability law w on nonsingular triples with every coordinate inclusion marginal <=1/2 has Z_w=exp(H(w)+sum w_S log v_S)=exp(-KL(w||v)) <= 2*sqrt(c*(1-c)). Thus the capped-basis Fresnel certificate 3e(D Z_w)^(-1/3) cannot be uniform at fixed D as c->1; its certificate loss is at least order (1-c)^(-1/6).

For m divisible by 4, balanced four sign pairs, r0=sqrt(c)e1 and rj=(sqrt(a)eta_j,sigma_j,tau_j)/sqrt(m), with B=[[0,1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,1]], the frame is Parseval and A=RBR^T has nonzero spectrum {1,-1,1}. Rows occupy five line directions, so finite-line-bank compression gives ||p_Q||_infty<450 uniformly for all independent cap-one inputs. The admissible law w*=0.5 v(.|hub in)+0.5 v(.|hub out) has hub marginal 1/2, leaf marginals 5/(2m), and exactly saturates Z_w=2 sqrt(ca).

A separate strict-N3 near-coloop family has true density <7.60 by mixed-hub/product-provenance methods while its exact full absolute spectral Fresnel coefficient diverges logarithmically as a=1-c->0. Read REPORT.md together with CORRECTION.md.
